title: ha-ros2-bridge contract 1: shared definitions
description: Definitions shared by every payload schema of contract version 1. Referenced by relative id from the per-kind schemas. Schema 1 only ever gains optional fields.

schema_version.description: Contract version carried by every JSON payload. Receivers ignore unknown fields; schema 1 only gains optional fields.

robot_id.description: Robot identifier used as a topic segment. Lower-case, starts with a letter, at most 32 characters. The segment 'ha' is reserved for Home Assistant's own topics and is refused.

task_id.description: Command id generated by Home Assistant. A lower-case UUID4 string. It names the reply topics, so both halves validate it before any topic is built.

session.description: A new UUID4 per node process. Informational on the HA side: it detects a node restart and never filters replies.

task_name.description: Task name from the announced catalogue. Same pattern as a robot id.

epoch_ms.description: Timestamp as integer epoch milliseconds, UTC.

params_subset.description: The JSON Schema subset a task may declare for its parameters: an object whose properties are primitive typed, each optionally constrained by enum, minimum and maximum, plus a required list. Both halves validate params by hand-written code against this subset.

ack_code.description: Closed set of acknowledgement codes. Exactly one code, 'accepted', means the command was taken on; every other code is a rejection.

result_status.description: Terminal status of an accepted task, mapped onto action_msgs/GoalStatus: succeeded 4, cancelled 5, aborted 6.

result_code.description: Machine-readable result or error code. Recommended vocabulary: ok, cancelled, preempted, collision, self_collision, no_trajectory, planning_failed, control_failed, timeout, invalid_goal, controller_error, unavailable, inhibited, executor_error, executor_unresponsive, nothing_to_pause, unknown. The HA-synthesised codes no_ack, no_result, node_restarted and ha_restarted never travel on the wire.

instance.description: Identity of the publishing node process as '<hostname>:<pid>', carried in announce, state and heartbeat so two nodes claiming one robot id are visible.

ha_instance_id.description: Identifier of the Home Assistant config entry that published a command or heartbeat.

task_kind.description: motion: rejected while busy, in error or inhibited, owns the single active slot. control: accepted in any state (stop, pause, resume). query: accepted in any state, no motion.

ha_link.description: Whether the node currently sees the Home Assistant heartbeat.

watchdog_mode.description: What the node does when the HA heartbeat stops. none is the default and is informational only.

executor_health.description: Last reported health of the executor plugin.

error.description: Robot-level error, or null when none. A failed task alone never sets this.

source.description: Who caused a command. origin names the publishing system (ha for Home Assistant); kind names the entry point (intent, button, service, automation and so on). The remaining fields are HA identifiers and may be null.

sig.description: Lower-case hex HMAC-SHA256 over topic + newline + canonical JSON of the payload without sig. Present only when a shared secret is configured.

joint_unit.description: Unit of every joint position in the announce joints block and on the joints topic: deg for degrees, rad for radians. Added 2026-10-14 (0.2.0) with the optional joint telemetry.

joint_name.description: Name of one joint as announced. Same pattern as a robot id; nothing reserved. Added 2026-10-14 (0.2.0).

joint_limits.description: One [minimum, maximum] pair per announced joint, in the announced unit and in the order of names. The length must equal the length of names; a schema cannot check that, so both halves check it in code. Added 2026-10-14 (0.2.0).
